conclusion: The monster target box (怪物目标框) is a code-drawn composite of 5 draw functions plus per-frame layout computation, all anchored to HUD+0xE4/+0xE8 (screen pixels). There is no dedicated target-box WIL frame; the name-plate box is drawn with a 0xA0A0A border, the HP bar texture comes from runtime-bound selector elements, and the name text uses selector 0x566DD4 frames 2/3.

anchor.semantics: screen-pixel anchor consumed by all five components

world_derived_path.condition: arg3 (mouse screen x) nonzero -> overwrite anchor

formulas.note: 48(width)x32(height) pixel tile world->screen; viewport consts 0xC8=200 / 0x9D=157; HUD+0xCC/0xD0 = mouse world pos (=ROOT+0x2F884C/0x2F8850); obj = [esp+0x24] hovered object; obj+0x12C/+0x130 world x/y; +0x134/+0x138 sprite pixel offsets

fixed_path.note: writes [HUD+0xE4]=0x178, [HUD+0xE8]=0xE3 then calls 0x40F5F0 which keeps them when arg3==0; no direct E8 callers (indirect dispatch); gate byte [HUD+0x62A48]

components.name: name-plate box (名字牌框)
components.vtable_entry: HUD vtable+0x84, called per-frame @0x41C063 with ecx = [ROOT+0x364444] current target

geometry.note: box hugs text width w, height 15px, fully above anchor (15..30px), horizontally centered on anchor

components.draw: 0x45DE50(0x8AB7A8, 0, color=0xA0A0A, 0, &name, 0, rect) x3 (outer -1/+1 border, inner +1, text rect)

components.name: HP bar (HP 条)
components.registry: 0x4542A0 (ecx=0x5600FC, flag, type, value) -> cached handle (registry array 0x57405C)
components.frame: 0x466130(ecx=element, frame=[0x61B9C]) -> frame record [edi+0x38]: word[0]=w, word[2]=h, word[4]=fx, word[6]=fy
components.position: x = anchor_x + fx + w/2 - 400 (0x476474); y = 300 (0x476470) - anchor_y - fy - h/2; bar frames fx=fy=0 -> bar right of anchor center by w/2, above by h/2

components.name: hovered entity re-render (悬停实体重绘)

type_db.lookup: 0x449B90: linear scan, record stride 0x30, match word[record+0xC] == type

record_fields.+0xE..0x1A: -> [HUD+0x61BAA..0x61BB6] (9 config bytes; +0x16/17/18 -> 61BB2/3/4 RGB, +0x1A -> 61BB5 alpha, all x0.003922f)

selector_select.offset_adjust: dx = [8A]:[8B]; if dx==0x8D and [C0]==4 -> arg*20 else arg*10 added to 61BA0/61BA4

msg1_path.call: push 0x5600FC; push word[HUD+0x62A38]; mov ecx,esi(HUD); call 0x40A4D0
msg1_path.after: sets [HUD+0x61BB8]=1 (HP bar mode); per-type [+0x61BA9]: 0x1C->0x14, 0x18->0xB, 0xB->0xD, 0x4E->0xE; then 0x45AFC0(0x8AB130, x, y, (type+0x3E8)*10, 0) ground marker

steps: [+0x89]==7 and [esp+0x2C]==-1 -> player path: 0x44A820(0x8AA5A8,7,1,id) -> vtable+0x10, send msg 0xBC7 (0x451450, 0x8AB828), [+0x62AE8]=1, [+0x62A4C]=0, return
[+0x629D3]==0 and word[+0x62A77]>7 -> send vtable+0x10(msg 0x1A, id), call 0x40A4D0(HUD, 0x5600FC, 0x1A, id), [+0x61BBC]=1, send msg 0xBD1, [+0x629D3]=2, [+0x62A4C]=0, return
[+0x629D2]==0 and word[+0x62A77]>0xB -> send vtable+0x10(msg 0x10), call 0x40A4D0(HUD, 0x5600FC, 0x23, id), [+0x61BBC]=1, send msg 0xBD8, return

resource_binding.name_text: selector 0x566DD4 frames 2/3 (frame numbers primary-static; WIL filename runtime bss binding, candidate)
resource_binding.hp_bar: selector element 0x5600FC + [HUD+0x8D]*0x144, frame = HP value (primary-static); GameInter.wil has 1103 frames and NO frames >= 10000 (primary-static-absence negative evidence for the 0x40F5F0 10000+(A%400) series); actual WIL family runtime-bound, candidate
resource_binding.target_portrait: status-window portrait/name area 49x33 (loop7 this+0x200) exists (primary-static); NPCface.wil frames are ~100x122 full-body (does not match); portrait frame source runtime-bound, candidate
resource_binding.frame_dispatch: 0x466130 mode byte [element+4]: 0 -> 0x466640, 1/2 -> 0x466720 (both direct frame-by-index via [element+0x30] offset table; validates header w/h <= 0x1000)
